in_marathi.name: Mahadevan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahadevan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahadevan is a compound name derived from Maha (great) and Devan (god). Mahadevan is considered to be the greatest of all gods in Hinduism, representing the supreme power and creator of the universe.

Mahadevan is considered to be the greatest of all gods in Hinduism, representing the supreme power and creator of the universe.
